subject: How to free one threshold for partial invariance

messages.author: 7014752e577b87d2
messages.subject: How to free one threshold for partial invariance
parts:
Hi,

I am assessing measurement invariance of dichotomous indicators and I want to free one of the thresholds using the group.partial option in the cfa function. I have tried group.partial = c('math=~i19', 'i19|t1~1'), but the threshold is still constrained between the groups (see the full code below). How do I free the threshold using this command? I was able to free intercepts when working with continuous indicators, but not for thresholds.

fit3 <- cfa(model1, data = math.dat, group = "group",
            group.equal = c("loadings", "thresholds"),
            group.partial = c('math=~i19', 'i19|t1~1'),
            ordered = names(math.dat), parameterization="theta")

Thanks,

Craig Wells

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: How to free one threshold for partial invariance
parts: An individual threshold may not be statistically identified for dichotomous indicators, depending on the rest of your model.
